decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is a commoditised add-on facing strong competition from cloud collaboration tools. It is close to the core offer and costs little to carry given the firm's slack from expansion, so management keeps it while monitoring it against aspirations.
The metro data centre network shows concrete adoption by financial customers. That exceeds aspirations and fits the firm's strategic direction toward high-bandwidth data centre connectivity.

Optical spectrum connectivity leverages the owned fibre and is presented on its own page, which signals management commitment. It is central to the high-bandwidth strategy, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The number ordering portal is a low-cost digital support tool that streamlines voice provisioning, in line with the move toward real-time self-service.

Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy telephony service in a shrinking market and is a likely candidate for pruning. Still, it runs on existing infrastructure and slack lets the firm carry it for another year.
Direct voice network connection is a core enterprise voice offering close to the established business, with no evidence of a shortfall that would call for reallocating its resources.
